' 'app.infra.test A'; dig @localhost app.infra.test. A +norecurse +noall +answer +authority +comments; printf '%s
' 'status.infra.test TXT'; dig @localhost status.infra.test. TXT +norecurse +noall +answer +authority +comments; printf '%s

' 'dig unavailable'; exit 127; fi

' 'failed-units'; systemctl --failed --no-legend --plain 2>&1 || true; printf '%s

' 'named-checkconf-z'; if command -v named-checkconf >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n -H named-checkconf -z /etc/named.conf 2>&1; else printf '%s
